basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old amateur astronomer based in Portland, Oregon. By day, I'm a software developer for a tech startup, and by night, I explore the cosmos with my trusty Celestron telescope. My passion for stargazing started when I was a kid, and it's only grown over the years. Besides astronomy, I enjoy playing Go, which led me to subreddit 'baduk', and occasionally I dive into 'pokemonmaxraids' for a bit of fun. I'm currently single and usually online late at night when the skies are clear. I dislike light pollution and cloudy nights.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in computer science, having earned a degree in it. My astronomy knowledge is mostly self-taught through books, online courses, and many sleepless nights under the stars. I frequent astronomy forums and subreddits to stay updated and share experiences.
